description:
Browse NTEE (National Taxonomy of Exempt Entities) classification codes.

NTEE codes are used to classify nonprofit organizations by their primary
purpose. This tool helps you find the right NTEE code for searching or
understanding a foundation's focus area.

category.description:
Single letter (A-Z) to browse codes in a major category.
     Example: "A" for Arts, Culture & Humanities
             "B" for Education
             "E" for Health Care
             "P" for Human Services

query.description:
Search term to find codes by description (case-insensitive).
   Example: "education", "youth", "environment"

name: get_ntee_codes
title: Browse NTEE Codes
